question: Can a CANARY_LITE Agent workflow produce a sufficiently stable, coverage-bounded parent-natural-event ledger for visible central-image obstruction from a fitness-ranked admitted RGB set, while an excluded technical smoke confirms that a reference model-B interface is usable before labeling scales?
non_goals: evaluating event-level effect, selecting, tuning, or comparing YOLO, SegFormer, DDRNet, depth, anomaly segmentation, or any other model-B candidate
selecting a topology operator, free-space threshold, category remapping, or fusion rule
estimating intended route, user motion intent, real traversability, collision risk, or safety
changing Android, A568, the default model, risk, event, feedback, or production behavior
granting D0-B execution, Confirmation, Deployment, product, or real-user authority

data_partitions.identity_basis: D0-A0 ranks existing accessible source/session candidates by current-question fitness and cost, admits the smallest adequate bundle, and records considered-but-not-admitted sessions without requiring byte-level inventory of every accessible asset.
data_partitions.reuse_policy: REUSE_FIRST_AND_FITNESS_FIRST. Prior use by another algorithm, mainline, or experiment is never a dataset-level exclusion by itself. Disclose actual prior access and claim overlap per session, assign the strongest honest current role, and never infer unseen Confirmation status.

reuse_first_admission_policy.principle: Existing high-value data are ranked for the current question before any new acquisition. Admission stops once the frozen sufficiency rule is met; the workflow does not inventory every accessible archive merely for completeness. Historical use changes the honest evidence role only when accessed information overlaps the current claim and never globally seals a dataset name or source family.
fitness_dimensions: continuous RGB payload is present and decodable
frame order and source/session identity are reconstructable
the frozen central image attention region is visible often enough to review
parent-event grouping is possible without candidate-model output
camera quality and NOT_EVALUABLE causes can be recorded
session ancestry and independence group can be disclosed
reuse_first_admission_policy.ranking_and_stop_rule: Rank by current-task observability, identity integrity, event diversity, access cost, and claim overlap. Freeze the ranked shortlist and an adequacy rule before labelability pilot; stop admitting sessions when the rule is satisfied, and record later candidates as NOT_NEEDED_FOR_CURRENT_CANARY rather than excluded or unusable.
role_rules: CONTENT_INSPECTED data remain eligible for D0-A when the admitted bundle and selection basis are disclosed.
Prior algorithm output that is unrelated to the central-obstruction claim is disclosed but does not automatically reduce the current role.
Prior output, selection, or tuning that overlaps the current claim limits the affected minimum identity unit to Canary or Development for that claim; it does not discard the data.
Uninspected independent sessions from a previously used dataset may be reserved for a future frozen evaluation when their identity and leakage boundary are established before access.
Frames, clips, or windows from one parent event or capture session never create artificial independence.
reuse_first_admission_policy.downgrade_before_discard: If a source cannot support the strongest desired role, first assign a truthful lower role such as calibration, Canary, Development diagnostic, regression fixture, stress case, negative sample, or source characterization. Exclude it from the current question only when current-task observability, identity, integrity, or bounded processing requirements are genuinely absent.
reuse_first_admission_policy.no_new_data_implication: A D0-A0 reuse audit does not authorize new collection or download. It ranks and assigns roles to existing accessible assets first and stops on adequacy; any later source expansion requires its own bounded decision.

observation_contract.roi_semantics: A frozen image-space region only; not intended route, body heading, future trajectory, free space, or a safety corridor.
observation_contract.parent_event_rule: Consecutive observations belonging to one natural obstruction or one continuous not-evaluable episode form one parent event. Frames and derived windows are longitudinal repeats, never independent event samples.

agent_review_workflow.low_risk_route: One isolated Agent label plus a frozen sampled independent audit. The sampling rule and audit rate are fixed after D0-A1 calibration and before production labeling.
agent_review_workflow.claim_critical_route: Positive events, NOT_EVALUABLE episodes, ambiguous boundaries, terminal-changing items, and any calibration-defined high-risk stratum receive two isolated passes.
agent_review_workflow.agreement_route: Only items with two matching isolated labels and boundaries form model consensus. Unreviewed low-risk items remain single-Agent labels with sampled-audit status.
agent_review_workflow.disagreement_route: A third fresh Agent adjudicates only material disagreement in audited or claim-critical items after first labeling the same frozen evidence independently.
agent_review_workflow.unresolved_route: Quarantine only the affected item as NOT_EVALUABLE; do not create or wait on a human task.

phase_plan.name: RANKED_REUSE_ADMISSION
phase_plan.output: Reuse-first ranked candidate ledger, frozen adequacy/stop rule, and the smallest admitted source/session bundle with identity, ancestry and role disclosure.

phase_plan.name: LABELABILITY_AND_AUDIT_PILOT
phase_plan.output: Excluded calibration bundle, frozen prompt and ROI, event-boundary/matching rule, ambiguity strata, sampled-audit rule, readiness thresholds, and prompt/input identities.

phase_plan.name: EXCLUDED_MODEL_B_TECHNICAL_SMOKE
phase_plan.output: On calibration-only RGB excluded from readiness and later effect evaluation, one declared reference model-B implementation is checked only for loadability, output schema, spatial resolution, finite values, and bounded runtime. No event metric, category selection, tuning, comparison, or topology choice is allowed.
phase_plan.candidate_output_visibility: TECHNICAL_SMOKE_EXECUTOR_ONLY; hidden from all label reviewers and readiness labels

phase_plan.name: RISK_TIERED_PRODUCTION_LABELING
phase_plan.output: One complete primary Agent ledger over the admitted bundle, plus two-pass ledgers for frozen claim-critical/ambiguous strata and the frozen independent audit sample.

phase_plan.name: CONSENSUS_AND_ADJUDICATION
phase_plan.output: Audit and material-disagreement receipts plus a derived canonical ledger that preserves whether each item is single-Agent, audited agreement, adjudicated, or NOT_EVALUABLE.

phase_plan.name: EVENT_LEVEL_READINESS_AUDIT
phase_plan.output: Parent-event sampled agreement, claim-critical agreement, source/session coverage, label distribution, audit/adjudication burden, NOT_EVALUABLE burden, technical-smoke status, limitations, and one terminal.

artifact_contract.immutability: Raw reviewer and adjudicator outputs are append-only evidence. The canonical ledger is derived and cannot overwrite them.

constraints.description: No label reviewer, adjudicator, event generator, or readiness evaluator may read model-B technical-smoke output, YOLO, segmentation, depth, fusion, scheduler, risk, feedback, or prior candidate-effect output. The isolated D0-AT executor may read only its excluded calibration input and reference model output.

The ranked shortlist, adequacy rule, admitted source/session frame ranges, and identities must be frozen before production labeling; easy segments cannot be added and difficult segments cannot be shortened or removed after inspection. Exhaustive inventory of assets outside the admitted bundle is not required.

A dataset, source family, or session cannot be excluded solely because another algorithm, mainline, or experiment used data with the same name. Exclusion must cite a current-task fitness, identity, integrity, or claim-overlap reason at the minimum affected identity unit.

D0-A0 evaluates current-question observability and actual prior information access per session before assigning the present evidence role. Dataset prestige, novelty, or historical project ownership cannot substitute for this audit.

Prior claim-relevant access normally downgrades the affected unit to calibration, Canary, Development, diagnostic, regression, or stress-case use. It does not justify deleting or globally sealing otherwise useful evidence.
Annotation, review, adjudication, and readiness acceptance are autonomous. No human-required queue, fallback, or pending gate may be created.

Every produced primary label, independent audit, claim-critical second pass, and adjudication is retained with its input identity; canonical derivation cannot overwrite or silently repair raw labels or boundaries. Full hash-bound consensus applies only where two-pass authority is claimed.
Parent natural events are the analysis units. Frames, overlapping windows, and multiple observations from one parent event remain grouped longitudinal repeats.
The protocol may state only no visible central obstruction evidence; it cannot emit CLEAR, SAFE, FREE_SPACE, TRAVERSABLE, UNKNOWN_OBSTACLE, or equivalent real-world claims.

D0-A1 calibration and D0-AT technical-smoke items cannot contribute to D0-A4 readiness counts or later event-effect evaluation. The matching rule, ambiguity strata, audit sampling rule, and numeric readiness thresholds must be frozen before D0-A2.
Unresolved review or event-boundary disagreement becomes NOT_EVALUABLE for the affected item; it cannot be converted into a forced positive or negative label.
D0-AT may establish only model load/output/interface plausibility on excluded data. It cannot select or tune a model, category mapping, topology operator, threshold, or claim event-level increment.

freeze.lock_transition: After D0-A1 freezes the admitted manifest, prompts, ambiguity/audit rules, matching rule, and readiness thresholds, any production-label change creates a new evidence instance; a material question, label, or estimand change requires a new protocol version.

READY_FOR_D0_B_AGENT_LABELED_DEVELOPMENT.meaning: The frozen Agent workflow produced a sufficiently stable and covered risk-tiered Agent label ledger under the D0-A1 lock, and the excluded reference model-B interface smoke was valid.

HOLD_DATA.meaning: The admitted continuous-RGB universe lacks sufficient scoreable parent events, source/session coverage, or required scene/quality coverage.

AGENT_LABEL_PROTOCOL_NOT_RELIABLE.meaning: The observable, event-boundary, matching, agreement, adjudication, or abstention process is not stable enough for D0-B.

HOLD_MODEL_B_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY.meaning: The isolated reference model-B smoke could not establish a usable load/output interface under the declared calibration-only conditions.

successor_policy.pass_successor: A separate DEVELOPMENT_STANDARD D0-B design may predeclare a bounded shortlist of at most three causally distinct model-B/operator candidates on burned development data, a fixed selection budget and rule, then freeze one candidate before held-out A versus C event-level evaluation.
successor_policy.hold_successor: Retain the immutable inventory and labelability diagnosis; acquire or reclassify evidence only under a new bounded source plan.
successor_policy.unreliable_successor: Revise the observation definition or Agent workflow in a new version; do not run model B against unstable labels.

experiment_design.minimal_discriminating_experiment: Rank existing sessions and stop on frozen adequacy; calibrate labelability and a sampled-audit rule on excluded data; run one excluded model-B interface smoke; scale to one full primary label ledger with two-pass review only for claim-critical, ambiguous, and sampled-audit items.
experiment_design.resource_budget: Existing continuous RGB only; one declared reference model-B technical smoke on excluded calibration data; bounded Agent review and local validation; no model comparison, event-effect evaluation, topology selection, Android, device, network training, or production execution.
experiment_design.stop_conditions: Stop when the frozen adequacy rule is met or at the first valid D0-A terminal. Do not add sessions after production labeling starts, evaluate model-B event effect, select a topology feature, or tune the smoke implementation.
experiment_design.efficiency_strategy: Use fitness-ranked reuse, stop-on-adequacy, a small labelability pilot, risk-tiered review, and an isolated technical smoke before scaling; preserve raw labels and audit status without manufacturing full-universe duplicate reviews.

hypotheses.theoretical_or_empirical_basis: Central-image visible obstruction is a narrower observable than intended-route traversability and can be reviewed from frozen RGB without candidate-model output.
hypotheses.causal_difference: Separates whether the observation can be defined reliably from whether any segmentation model later adds event-level information to YOLO.
hypotheses.expected_information_gain: Determines whether a D0-B model-increment experiment has a stable risk-tiered Agent-labeled event denominator with measured independent-audit reliability, or should stop before model search.
hypotheses.minimal_test: A calibration labelability pilot, frozen sampled independent audit, claim-critical two-pass review, material-disagreement adjudication, and one excluded model-B interface smoke.
hypotheses.evaluation_metric: Sampled parent-event agreement, claim-critical agreement, source/session and event-type coverage, audit/adjudication burden, NOT_EVALUABLE burden, and technical-smoke validity under D0-A1 thresholds.
hypotheses.falsifier: The frozen workflow cannot produce stable parent-event labels/boundaries or adequate cross-session scoreable coverage without candidate-output access.
hypotheses.resource_budget: Fitness-ranked existing continuous RGB, one primary Agent pass, bounded independent audit and adjudication, one excluded reference model-B technical smoke, and local validation.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Return HOLD_DATA, AGENT_LABEL_PROTOCOL_NOT_RELIABLE, or HOLD_MODEL_B_TECHNICAL_FEASIBILITY and do not run D0-B effect evaluation.
hypotheses.selection_reason: It is the cheapest direct test of whether the proposed heterogeneous double-loop question is answerable before selecting or deploying a second model.

failure_learning.observation: No D0-A input manifest, calibration, production review, adjudication, or readiness audit has run under this protocol.
alternative_explanations: The current source universe may lack visible central-obstruction diversity.
The ROI or event-boundary definition may be intrinsically ambiguous under head turns, blur, darkness, or occlusion.
Agent reviewers may share correlated visual priors despite context isolation.
reuse_candidates: The frozen input inventory can remain a source-characterization asset.
Disagreement and NOT_EVALUABLE episodes can become future stress cases.
The review prompts and receipts can remain regression fixtures.

claim_ceiling: AGENT_LABELED_WITH_RISK_TIERED_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT / CANARY_ONLY. Only actually double-reviewed items may be called model consensus. A READY terminal means only that a D0-B DEVELOPMENT_STANDARD design is answerable and a reference interface was technically plausible on excluded calibration data. It is not human ground truth, objective sensor truth, model increment, traversability, real-user effect, safety, product, or deployment evidence.
